cues.en: We're going to use the Python programming language in this course, as it's pretty easy to learn and use, and it's widely used in the world of data science and machine learning.
cues.zh: 本課程會使用 Python 程式語言，因為它相當容易學習與使用，也廣泛應用在資料科學與機器學習領域。

cues.en: In the real world, you'll get much better performance using languages like Java or C++, but I didn't want to shut out students who aren't comfortable with lower-level languages like that.
cues.zh: 在真實世界，使用 Java 或 C++ 等語言，效能會好得多，但我不想讓不熟悉這類較低階語言的學生無法參與。

cues.en: Anyhow, if you already know Python, you can totally skip this section.
cues.zh: 總之，如果已經會 Python，完全可以跳過這一節。

cues.en: But if you're new to Python or you need a refresher, I've got a very quick crash course for you here.
cues.zh: 但如果是 Python 新手，或需要複習，這裡準備了一個非常快速的入門課程。

cues.en: You are going to need some experience in programming or scripting for this to make sense, I mean I can't teach you to program from scratch in just one section of a course.
cues.zh: 你需要具備一些程式或指令碼撰寫經驗，才能理解這些內容；畢竟我無法只用課程的一個章節，就從零教你寫程式。

cues.en: So if you've never programmed anything before, it would be a good idea to go grab a deeper introductory course on Python and go through that first, before coming back to this course.
cues.zh: 所以，如果以前完全沒寫過程式，建議先找一門更深入的 Python 入門課程學完，再回來上這門課。

cues.en: Otherwise, let's shoulder on and learn the basics of Python!
cues.zh: 否則，就繼續學習 Python 的基礎吧。

cues.en: For our intro to Python, we're going to use a format called a Notebook, this allows us to intersperse code with nicely formatted text that explains what's going on, and lets us run our code in one little chunk at a time.
cues.zh: Python 入門會使用叫做 Notebook 的格式，能在程式碼之間穿插排版良好的說明文字，並一次執行一小段程式碼。

cues.en: So the first thing we need to do is install a component into Anaconda called Jupyter Notebook.
cues.zh: 因此，首先要在 Anaconda 中安裝 Jupyter Notebook 元件。

cues.en: To do that, just open up Anaconda Navigator,
cues.zh: 開啟 Anaconda Navigator，

cues.en: click on Environments, and select our RecSys environment.
cues.zh: 按 Environments，選取 RecSys 環境。

cues.en: Now click on Home, and under Jupyter Notebook, hit install.
cues.zh: 接著按 Home，在 Jupyter Notebook 下方按 Install。

cues.en: Once it's done, hit Launch, and it should bring up a page in your web browser.
cues.zh: 完成後按 Launch，應該會在網頁瀏覽器開啟一個頁面。

cues.en: Now hit the upload button, and navigate to the Getting Started folder inside your course materials.
cues.zh: 按 Upload，找到課程教材中的 GettingStarted 資料夾。

cues.en: In there select the Python101.ipynb file.
cues.zh: 在裡面選取 Python101.ipynb 檔案。

cues.en: It should now appear at the top of your file list.
cues.zh: 它現在應該出現在檔案清單頂端。

cues.en: Hit the upload button next to it.
cues.zh: 按它旁邊的 Upload 按鈕。

cues.en: And once it's uploaded, find it in the file list and select it to open it.
cues.zh: 上傳完成後，在檔案清單中找到它，選取並開啟。

cues.en: If you've never seen a Jupyter notebook before, the way it works is you can click in any of these boxes of code, and hit the run button, or shift-enter, and it will execute that code
cues.zh: 如果以前沒看過 Jupyter Notebook，它的使用方式是點選任一程式碼方塊，再按 Run 或 Shift+Enter，就能

cues.en: right from your web browser.
cues.zh: 直接從網頁瀏覽器執行這段程式碼。

cues.en: Let's try it with this first block.
cues.zh: 用第一個區塊試試看。

cues.en: Click inside of it to select it, and hit shift-enter.
cues.zh: 點選區塊內部，然後按 Shift+Enter。

cues.en: Now, we're just going to cover the syntax of Python here and the main ways in which it differs from other languages.
cues.zh: 這裡只會介紹 Python 語法，以及它與其他語言最主要的差異。

cues.en: So let's take a closer look at this code.
cues.zh: 仔細看看這段程式碼。

cues.en: One thing with Python is that whitespace is really important.
cues.zh: Python 的一個特點是，空白非常重要。

cues.en: Any nesting of code, like for iteration or conditional expressions, relies on the number of tabs to group code together, instead of curly brackets like other languages.
cues.zh: 像是迭代或條件運算式的程式碼巢狀結構，靠縮排數量將程式碼分組，而不是其他語言使用的大括號。

cues.en: So here we have a list of numbers.
cues.zh: 這裡有一個數字串列。

cues.en: In Python, a list is like an array or a vector in other languages.
cues.zh: Python 的串列，類似其他語言的陣列或向量。

cues.en: We define a list of the numbers one through six by putting them in between square brackets, separated by commas.
cues.zh: 把一到六放在方括號中，用逗號分隔，就定義了一個數字串列。

cues.en: In Python, there is no character required to terminate a line, you just hit enter when you're done.
cues.zh: 在 Python 中，行尾不需要終止字元，寫完直接按 Enter 即可。

cues.en: Let's add seven to the list, just to prove that running this actually does something.
cues.zh: 在串列中加入七，證明執行它確實會有作用。

cues.en: Yeah, we've got results for one through seven now.
cues.zh: 沒錯，現在結果是一到七。

cues.en: Next we have an example of a "for" loop in Python.
cues.zh: 接著是 Python 的 for 迴圈範例。

cues.en: This statement iterates through the list named "listOfNumbers", storing the current iteration in the variable "number" each time.
cues.zh: 這個敘述會走訪名為 listOfNumbers 的串列，每次把目前的元素存入 number 變數。

cues.en: A "for" statement does have to end with a colon, like this.
cues.zh: for 敘述確實必須像這樣，以冒號結尾。

cues.en: But now we use indents to indicate what code lives within this "for" block.
cues.zh: 但我們用縮排，表示哪些程式碼屬於這個 for 區塊。

cues.en: And here we have an example of an "if/else" clause.
cues.zh: 這裡有一個 if/else 子句範例。

cues.en: If the number is evenly divisible by two, we print that it's even, otherwise we print that it's odd.
cues.zh: 如果數字能被二整除，就印出它是偶數，否則印出它是奇數。

cues.en: And again, we use indents to indicate what code lives within each if or else clause here.
cues.zh: 同樣地，這裡用縮排表示程式碼屬於哪個 if 或 else 子句。

cues.en: We'll remove all indents to get out of the "for" loop, and print "all done" at the end.
cues.zh: 移除所有縮排，就離開 for 迴圈，最後印出「all done」。

cues.en: Notice that we never had to declare any variable ahead of time, nor did we have to define their types.
cues.zh: 注意，我們不必預先宣告任何變數，也不用定義它們的型別。

cues.en: Python is what's called a dynamically typed language.
cues.zh: Python 是所謂的動態型別語言。

cues.en: It tries to infer the data type of your variables based on how you initially use them, but internally they do have types.
cues.zh: 它會根據你最初如何使用變數，推斷變數的資料型別，但內部確實有型別。

cues.en: You can also explicitly cast variables to different types if you need to, but variables won't be re-cast automatically as they would in weakly typed languages.
cues.zh: 必要時也可以明確將變數轉成其他型別，但變數不會像弱型別語言那樣自動轉型。

cues.en: Sometimes this can lead to unexpected errors, and we'll see some of that as we go through the course.
cues.zh: 有時這會導致意料之外的錯誤，課程中會看到一些例子。

cues.en: Let's move on to the next block, which just shows how to import external modules into your Python scripts.
cues.zh: 繼續下一個區塊，這裡只是示範如何把外部模組匯入 Python 指令碼。

cues.en: You just use the import command for this, and you can define an alias for the module if you'd like to save yourself some typing, too.
cues.zh: 使用 import 命令即可，也可以替模組定義別名，少打一些字。

cues.en: So, here we're importing the numpy module, so we can refer to it within our script, and we're importing it under the name "np".
cues.zh: 這裡匯入 numpy 模組，讓指令碼可以使用它，並用 np 這個名稱匯入。

cues.en: This lets us then use numpy's random function by just typing np.random, and in this case, we're asking numpy to give us ten normally-distributed random values
cues.zh: 之後只要輸入 np.random，就能使用 NumPy 的隨機函數；這個例子要求 NumPy 產生十個服從常態分布的隨機值，

cues.en: with a given mean and standard deviation.
cues.zh: 並指定平均值與標準差。
